title: UIBC revocation list report line
description: One line of a JSON Lines file produced by `uibc_core.pyz verify-revocation-list --report`. The line records what a signed, cumulative revocation list chain forced, and where the verifier stopped. The refusal travels with the position it was reached at, because a chain verdict without the position does not say which list was rejected.

vector.description: The corpus member this line is about.

result.description: PASS means the chain was read and every list held; FAIL means at least one list was refused; ERROR means the chain could not be read at all.

verdict.description: null only on an ERROR line.

reason.description: The refusal, as one of the peer's revocation_list_* tokens: shape, signer_not_a_root, signature_unverified, other_chain, rollback, gap, previous_mismatch, time_reversed, entry_from_future, drops_entry. Null on a valid chain or an ERROR line.

index.description: 0-based position of the list the verifier stopped on. Null when the refusal concerns the document as a whole rather than one entry.

exit.description: 0 for a valid chain, 1 for a refusal, 3 when nothing could be judged.

error.description: Present only on an ERROR line, and required there.

$comment: Cross-field rules the subset here cannot express: a valid verdict carries reason null and index null; a refusal carries a reason token; an ERROR line carries no verdict, no reason, no index, and an error string.
